Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.81 - Synced upstream Wrath Combo 1.0.4.14 -> 1.0.4.16 (job rotations, item/potion configs, crash fixes)
- Upstream job-rotation improvements across BRD, DRK, MCH, NIN, RPR, DNC, PCT, VPR, SAM, PLD, AST, MNK, SGE, SCH, SMN: opener fixes (DRK / DRG / BRD / AST), AoE and burst tuning, and an expanded DRK configuration.
- New item / potion usage system (Combos/PvE/ALL/Items.cs) with wired-up potion configs, plus a new "AoE manual ignore" option in the AutoRotation UI.
- Custom Action reliability: crash guards when reloading / hovering custom actions, a retired dead hook, and a fix for queueing the wrong action on overwrite.
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, Pyretic / Reflect penalties, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, BattleData, BLU engine, and IPC controls.
